title: A meeting point for fluids
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: The duodenum is the first part of the small intestine and receives bile and pancreatic juice through ducts.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Bile and pancreatic juice normally enter the duodenum. Which part of the digestive tract is the duodenum? The duodenum is the first part of the small intestine and receives bile and pancreatic juice through ducts.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
